notes.title: Chapter 2 Release Update – Now Coming in September
notes.notes: [p][b]Dear Players,[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]We want to thank you once again for your continued support and patience with The Midnight Crimes.[/b][/p][p][b]While we’ve made great progress on Chapter 2, we’ve come to the decision to postpone its release until September. e know this is disappointing news, especially after the previous delay, and we truly appreciate your understanding.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Our goal remains the same: to deliver an experience that captures the dark, immersive essence of Midnight Cove, with every clue, line of dialogue, and scene crafted with care. This additional time will allow us to polish the game further and ensure it meets the quality we know you expect and deserve.[/b][/p][p][b]As always, we’ll be sharing more behind-the-scenes content and story previews as we approach the new release window.[/b][/p][p][b]The mystery continues... and we can’t wait to show you what’s coming next.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Sincerely,[/b][/p][p][b]The DeadlyCrow Games Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: New release date announced for Chapter 2 of The Midnight Crimes.
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your patience and excitement for The Midnight Crimes. We've been working hard on Chapter 2 to ensure it lives up to the dark, immersive atmosphere of Midnight Cove.
To deliver the best experience possible, we’ve decided to delay the release. Although it was planned for this month, we need more time to refine every detail clues, dialogues, and scenes alike.
This means that all subsequent episodes will also be delayed in their release.
We truly appreciate your support. As a thank you, we’ll be sharing new previews and exclusive story content in the coming weeks. The mystery of Midnight Cove continues, and we can’t wait for you to see what’s next.
Chapter Two of The Midnight Crimes will be released on July, 2025

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
[b]Sincerely,
DeadlyCrow Games Team[/b]

notes.title: 🎩🔍 Important Update on The Midnight Crimes
notes.notes:
Due to unforeseen circumstances, the release of Chapter 1 has been postponed by a few days. We’re committed to delivering the best experience possible and appreciate your patience.

We’ll announce the new date soon! Thank you for your support and excitement for this noir adventure. 🖤

notes.title: NEWS!! December 20th: The Midnight Crimes Official Release! 🕵️
notes.notes:
We´re  thrilled to announce that the first chapter of six of our long-awaited narrative adventure, The Midnight Crimes, is officially launching this [b]December 20th on Steam[/b]! 🕵️‍♂️✨ 

Step into the shadowy streets of a noir-inspired city, where mysteries abound, and danger lurks in every corner. This point-and-click adventure combines gripping storytelling, atmospheric horror, and intricate puzzles to immerse players in a haunting cinematic experience.

Following the success of our demo, featured in events like the Latin American Showcase and Devcom, we are incredibly excited to share the full game with you.

Wishlist The Midnight Crimes now and prepare for a journey that will keep you on the edge of your seat!
